units: <cite ref="Yevamot 118b:16">Yeb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ דגופא וכ׳</he> bodily comfort (even in an unhappy marriage) is preferable (to singleness).
Sabb. 132ᵃ מעיקרא מאי קא נ׳ ליה וכ׳ what satisfactory reason had he at first (for his interpretation), and what was again the objection he attempted to meet?—נ׳ ל־ one likes, prefers.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:50">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 50</cite>.—
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:13">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אתייקורי</he> … <he>לא נ׳ לי</he> I do not want to be honored at the expense of thy disgrace.

<cite ref="Megillah 28a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נ׳ לכו וכ׳</he> do you not want me to live? <cite ref="Bava Batra 172a:7">B. Bath. 172ᵃ</cite> <he>מילתא דנ׳ ליה וכ׳</he> something which is satisfactory to the creditor and &c.
<cite ref="Arakhin 30b:33">Arakh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ לאיניש דליזבן וכ׳</he> it is better for man to sell his daughter than to borrow on interest.
Erub. 32ᵇ; a. fr.—נִ׳, הָנִ׳ (a dialectical term, v. נוּחַ Ithpe.) it is right; it will do.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:10">Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ</cite> top <he>נ׳ העליונים וכ׳</he> this is right as far as the uppermost and nethermost cavities are concerned.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:6:6">Y. Yoma III, 40ᶜ</cite>, sq. <he>אין תימר מיד נ׳ אין תימר … נ׳ של משה וכ׳</he> if you say, sacred vessels are consecrated at once (as soon as finished), it is right; but if you say, they are not consecrated until they are used, it would be right as far as the Mosaic vessels are concerned, but &c.—
<cite ref="Chullin 56a:4">Ḥull. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>הנ׳ למאן דאמר</he> this would be right according to the opinion of &c.; a. fr.—
Cant. R. to I, 6 נ׳ (an editorial gloss, as a punctuation mark) as a positive assertion, opp. אִתְמְהָא.—V. נְיָיח.
